Jules: Thanks for the questions during the all-hands — leadership wanted a short, auditable follow-up thread so Sales/Support know which dates are firm vs tradeoffs. Please paste a single-line status update and label MUST or CAN_DEFER.
Ravi: API GA target = early-Q3 (4-6 weeks). MUST: final SLA clauses signed by Legal, pricing table confirmed. CAN_DEFER: noncritical admin endpoints. Owner: Ravi.
Marta: Console scope: mid-Q3 for core admin + rollout UI (dashboards, per-route config). MUST: rollout UI + model pinning. CAN_DEFER: Optimize recommendations UI, external APM link. Owner: Marta.
Ken: Optimize recommendations: public beta late-Q3, GA in Q4. MUST: 3 production evals showing cost wins; CAN_DEFER: full quantization suggestion UI. Owner: Ken (Research).
Jules: Small ask: which blockers are "hard stop" vs "mitigatable"? Add short note if you need headcount/time.
Ravi: Hard stop = SLA/legal. Mitigatable = gateway concurrency (have patch in review). Need 1 additional SRE day during canary.
Marta: Hard stop = rollout UI for customers relying on per-route rollouts. Mitigatable = APM integration (move to Q4). No extra headcount needed if we scope down widgets.
Ken: Hard stop = infra quota for per-tenant batched evals. If infra can't grant quota in 5 business days, beta slips ~3 weeks. Requesting quota change ticket (cc infra).
Jules: Ok. From leadership: prioritize SLA/legal and infra quota first. Defer APM and advanced Optimize UX if that clears path.
legal-bot: FYI: SLA redline review scheduled Fri 14:00 PT. Please ping @Legal if you need expedited review.
ops-bot: Roadmap sync reminder Thu 09:00 PT.
Ravi: Action items: 1) I will follow up with Legal and Finance for pricing (ETA 10 business days). 2) Push gateway patch to staging today; will post soak results.
Marta: Action items: 1) Publish Console GA checklist and mark deferrables by EOD tomorrow.
Ken: Action items: 1) Open infra quota ticket and tag infra owners; 2) queue remaining evals. ETA for ticket: 48h.
Jules: Thanks — I'll update the public tracker once checklist items land. If anything slips, update this thread. :thumbsup:
